slot_note: seed FC10 (nurse case-management teams across claim segments, workers' compensation); the seed's world, decision and quantity are kept (seventeen nurse teams of twenty places, eight claim segments, at most three teams a segment, the ultimate indemnity they save booked in the next accident year's pick, a randomised pilot verified by an independent actuarial review); its architecture (a saving conditioned on employers with light-duty capacity, a composition shift) is not used: composition_mix and pattern E are spent on task137 and banned against the last three builds. The pitfall is re-found from how the pilot's records come to exist: the pilot assigned intakes, the review verified indemnity claims, and the nurses decided which intakes became indemnity claims.
niche: a regional workers' compensation carrier placing seventeen early-intervention nurse teams across eight claim segments for accident year 2027 and booking the ultimate indemnity they save in the AY2027 indemnity pick, when the pilot's nurses kept part of their intakes from ever paying indemnity
answer: three teams each to HC-SS, MF-SS, MF-OT, CN-OT and HC-OT, two to RW-SS, none to RW-OT or CN-SS; an AY2027 indemnity credit of 4,100,000 dollars
answer_source: submission.md block 1 and golden/ern_placement_ay2027.xlsx (Placement), recomputed by generator/verify.py
stakeholder_role: director of medical case management, who places the nurse teams and supplies the saving to the AY2027 pick

spine.entity: one claim reported to the carrier with time off work at first report, or one that later paid indemnity
spine.source: constructed (the carrier's claims system listing of time-off and indemnity claims)

world.org_type: regional workers' compensation insurer (a stock carrier writing Missouri employers)

driver: An intervention assigned at random at intake changes how many of its units go on to become the recorded costly cases as well as what those cases cost, so its effect has to be read per assigned unit, each arm's own conversion times its own cost, and valued per unit of the capacity each assigned unit holds; read per recorded case, it compares a costlier remainder of one arm with the ordinary cases of the other and places the capacity where the recorded cases are dearest.
driver_concrete: The pilot assigned intakes with time off at first report at random, half to Early Return nurses, and the nurses kept about a fifth to a quarter of the healthcare, retail and manufacturing strain intakes from ever paying indemnity (back on suitable duties inside the waiting period), while the independent review verified a sample of indemnity claims only; the saving a team buys is indemnity per assigned intake (each arm's own indemnity-claim rate times its own verified severity) over the nurse place-days an assigned intake holds, which puts the teams in the strain segments, where the saving per verified indemnity claim reads as four to six per cent and leaves healthcare and retail strains without a team.
stump: A competent solver compares the verified ultimates of the two arms' indemnity claims in each segment, values each segment's teams per place-day of an indemnity claim at that saving and files teams in the other-injury and construction units, none in healthcare or retail strains, with a run-rate credit of 2,000,000 dollars; the step that lands it there is reading the saving per indemnity claim when the nurses kept part of their intakes from ever paying indemnity, so the programme arm's indemnity claims are the costlier remainder: per assigned intake the teams go to the strain segments, retail strains takes the two teams its intakes keep in use, and the credit is 4,100,000 dollars.
analyst_test: A strong analyst who reads the pilot register, the review, the charter and the pick memo right compares the verified ultimate indemnity of each arm's indemnity claims segment by segment and divides by the place-days a programme indemnity claim held, and that files teams in the other-injury and construction units, none in healthcare or retail strains, and a credit of 2,000,000 dollars, because the nurses kept about a fifth to a quarter of the strain intakes at work, so those segments' programme indemnity claims are the costlier remainder and their saving per claim reads as four to six per cent.
domain_test: The saving is a workers' compensation pure premium per intake, the indemnity-claim rate times indemnity severity at ultimate, read as the pilot was randomised and valued per nurse place-day; with another field's nouns there is no waiting period, no conversion of an intake into an indemnity claim and no stay-at-work on suitable duties, and the task stops reading the same.

differentiation.task136: task136 carries a campaign's yield to new sites per member still able to respond, a pool built through a join; here nothing is transported and no pool is built: within one randomised pilot the treatment itself changes which assigned intakes become the recorded indemnity claims, and the comparison has to be read per assigned intake
differentiation.task128: task128 reads a call's effect from a capacity-overflow natural experiment and fixes the unmarked undiallable records; here the pilot is randomised and the bias is the nurses' own effect on which intakes ever pay indemnity, with no natural experiment and no marking
differentiation.task124: task124 carries a rate measured on units examined because they showed signs of the outcome to a population all of which will be examined; here the forward population and the randomised one are the same intakes, and the error is a comparison conditioned on an outcome the treatment moves
differentiation.task452: task452 v2 weights a stratified reference sample by the inclusion probabilities of the strata it was drawn from after a reclassification moved points between classes; here no design weight is at issue: within one randomised pilot the treatment itself moves assigned intakes out of the recorded class, and the comparison is read per assigned intake, each arm's own conversion times its own verified severity

notes: stump_strategy causal_design: the decisive step is the comparison the randomised design implies (per assigned intake, as randomised), not a forward-population definition, because next year's teams take exactly the population the pilot randomised. G9 names the mechanism: the measured class (indemnity claims) is the downstream survivor of the upstream acquisition (intakes) and survival depends on the arm. Lower rungs: G1 per place-day (the slots bind), G14 per-segment yields.
